mapper.select: SELECT id, household_id, parent_id, name, name_normalized, sort_order, ever_referenced, created_at, updated_at, version FROM location WHERE household_id = #{householdId} ORDER BY sort_order, id

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT id FROM location WHERE id = #{locationId} AND household_id = #{householdId} UNION ALL SELECT l.id FROM location l INNER JOIN descendants d ON l.parent_id = d.id ) SELECT id FROM descendants
